snippet.title: Mozilla Hacks
snippet.description:
Learn the best of web development today, and discover what's ahead for the web of tomorrow with Mozilla. 

Official home of Mozilla Developer Outreach on YouTube. Companion to Mozilla Hacks, our blog for web designers, developers, and people who make websites. Mozilla Hacks, keeping the Web open and accessible since 2009. 

Created by Mozilla Developer Outreach team and many Mozillian friends, staff members, and volunteer contributors. Thank you!
